subject: Renewal paperwork: MSA clarifications, Exhibit D SLAs & order form reconciliation
messages:
From: Paulette Morgan <paulette@skylarkhealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@skylarkhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal paperwork + uplift — a few open items

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re moving forward with the renewal and the Q3 capacity uplift, but our legal and procurement teams have called out three items they want clarified before Countersign:

1) Exhibit D (SLAs): We need the SLO definitions for 99th pct latency for dedicated instances explicitly called out and what remedies apply for repeated breaches (they prefer a credit table).
2) Data residency / Ingress/egress: Procurement wants explicit language that customer data for Skylark’s dev environment remains in us-west and that backups are retained for 30 days — is that already handled in the private deployment addendum?
3) Order form quantities: The order form attached to the renewal shows a 40% uplift vs current committed units; procurement wants to treat 20% as committed and 20% as flexible burst capacity with pricing aligned to the Dedicated capacity SKU.

I attached a redline-pass from Skylark legal (Skylark_MSA_v3_redlines.docx) and the order form PDF. Can we get internal alignment on these three points and a consolidated response for their legal? The renewal is timeboxed — they want countersign by end of next week.

Best,
Paulette Morgan
VP Procurement, Skylark Health
Attachment: Skylark_MSA_v3_redlines.docx (docx, 42KB)
Attachment: OrderForm_SKY-4592_2025-06.pdf (pdf, 18KB)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal paperwork + uplift — Skylark redlines (need legal + product take)

Team — forwarding Skylark’s redline pass and order form. High level asks: SLA credit table for Exhibit D, a firm data residency statement for dev/backups, and confirmation on how we present committed vs burst capacity pricing on the order form.

Ask: Rachel, can you review the MSA redlines and confirm which of their requests are acceptable vs require counter-language? Marcus, can you confirm whether the Dedicated SKU pricing supports a flexible burst slab (20%) and draft a short clause we can put in the order form about burst capacity and billing. Laura, if procurement needs an executive note on timing/slas, can you prepare a 1-paragraph summary we can send to Paulette?

We need to get a consolidated reply to Skylark legal by COB Tuesday (2025-06-17) so countersign can proceed.

—Vivek
Senior GTM, Redwood Inference

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal paperwork + uplift — Skylark redlines (MSA notes)

Vivek / Marcus / Laura —

I reviewed Skylark_MSA_v3_redlines.docx and summarized the legal positions below (high level, with suggested response language):

1) Exhibit D / SLA credits: their requested credit table is broader than our standard. Suggest we propose a 30% cap on monthly credits for repeated breaches with an escalation path (first incident = root-cause + remediation plan; second incident = 10% credit; third incident within 90 days = 30% credit; termination rights reserved only for material repeated failure). Suggested reply: we can include a credit schedule tied to severity and recurrence; we cannot accept unlimited credit exposure.

2) Data residency and backups: Our Private addendum already notes region controls for customer-managed deployments. For Hosted customers we offer region selection but cannot guarantee backups are never replicated for infra reasons. Suggested reply: For Skylark (they are requesting a private deployment? check), commit to storing Skylark production and dev instances in us-west for the tenancy and retain daily backups for 30 days in-region for the Dedicated/Private offering; include a callout that any cross-region failover is subject to customer approval. If they are migrating to Redwood Private (VPC) we can add the explicit residency clause.

3) Order form uplift / burst: We can model 20% as 'committed' and an additional 'burst pool' priced at the Dedicated burst SKU at a 1.6x multiplier (example). Marcus — confirm if 1.6x is viable (or propose better). Also note: billing cycle and amortization of committed units needs explicit language (we normally prorate for mid-cycle changes).

I attached line-level comments in the docx and flagged the critical sections. I also marked a few places where legal wants indemnity/term changes that we should not accept as written — I propose counter-language in those paragraphs (see comments).

Next steps: Marcus to confirm pricing numbers; Laura to prepare the executive note; Vivek to send consolidated reply including tracked redline or a follow-up DocuSign packet.

Thanks,
Rachel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Skylark_MSA_v3_redlines.docx (docx, edited, 45KB)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal paperwork + uplift — pricing for committed vs burst

Quick pricing check — I ran model with infra and finance: we can offer the 20% committed at current dedicated rate. For the 20% burst, recommended: 1.5x of committed unit price for billed usage beyond committed baseline (capped at 20% of committed for each billing period unless they request a permanent uplift). Rationale: keeps revenue predictable while giving Skylark the operational headroom they want.

Also, for SLO credits impact to runway, finance wants the 30% monthly credit cap Rachel proposed; beyond that we need an executive escalation approval for termination or larger concessions.

I’ve prepared suggested contract language for the order form (short paragraph) and a simple table for the Exhibit D credit schedule — I can paste those into the MSA if legal approves.

—Marcus
Director, Commercial Pricing, Redwood Inference
Attachment: OrderForm_SKY-4592_2025-06.pdf (annotated, 22KB)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Paulette Morgan <paulette@skylarkhealth.com>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@skylarkhealth.com>
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + uplift — consolidated response and next steps

Hi Paulette / Jordan —

Thanks for the redline pass and the clear list of asks. We reviewed internally and can confirm the following path forward so you can take back to legal/procurement: 

1) Exhibit D (SLA credits): We will include a credit schedule tied to recurrence. Proposed table: first outage — root cause + remediation; second outage within 90 days — 10% monthly credit; third outage within 90 days — 30% monthly credit. Monthly credits are capped at 30% of that invoice. Termination for repeated failures remains subject to materiality and executive review. (Rachel put recommended contract language in the attached doc.)

2) Data residency & backups: Because Skylark has elected Dedicated/Private controls in the renewal, we will commit to keeping your tenant (prod + dev) and daily backups in us-west and retain backups for 30 days in-region. Any cross-region failover or replication will be performed only with prior approval. Our Private addendum will be appended to the MSA to capture this.

3) Order form uplift / pricing: We will treat 20% as newly committed units at the current Dedicated unit price. The additional 20% will be a burst pool billed at 1.5x the committed SKU rate, capped at 20% of committed volume per billing period unless you request a permanent change to committed capacity. Marcus attached an annotated order form with the pricing and the short paragraph to include on the order form. We will prorate for mid-cycle adjustments per our standard billing practice.

Next steps:
- Rachel to provide the tracked redline with counter language for the few indemnity/term items (attached).
- Marcus to update the order form with the 1.5x burst language (attached).
- Vivek to prepare a consolidated DocuSign packet once you confirm the above.

If that sounds good, can you confirm by tomorrow COB (Tue 2025-06-17) and we’ll issue the updated packet for countersign?

Appreciate the quick turnaround here — we want you to be able to deploy the extra capacity for your Q3 launch.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior GTM, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Skylark_MSA_v3_redlines.docx (redlined by Redwood, 47KB); OrderForm_SKY-4592_2025-06.pdf (annotated, 22KB); DocuSign packet link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123
